necessary_source_dependencies.statement: Measurable [0,1]-supported IID observations, causal history measurable predictors, independent complete private seed when randomized; derive independence of current observation.
Squared-error bias-variance identity, feasible mean, integrability, expected fixed minimum T variance, causal loss lower bound.
Positive-horizon division and equivalence of little-o total and ordinary zero average.
Finite square completion, nonnegative squared deviation, feasibility of arithmetic mean, positive-horizon uniqueness and value of interval minimum.
Recurrence for count and average, exact trajectory agreement with prefix mean, valid initial handling.
necessary_source_dependencies.sourceStatus: Derived proof of printed summary property; no bit-complexity theorem required.

necessary_source_dependencies.statement: T=1 reflexive base; T>=2 cancel common last summand Eq1.3; IH at T-1; prefix minimizer inequality against final feasible leader; chain; discharge IH by induction.
necessary_source_dependencies.sourceStatus: Printed complete induction; IH is local, not public assumption.

necessary_source_dependencies.statement: Use produced positive-prefix means in BTL; subtract terminal attained minimum to upper-bound regret by successive-leader loss differences.

First term singleton mean y1 and half start gives <=1/4. Later difference factors as (old+new-2y)(old-new), bounded by 2 abs(old-new); expand two means, triangle inequality and bounded prefix sum to <=4/t.
necessary_source_dependencies.sourceStatus: Printed source route, not a claim of matching native proof-term edges.

necessary_source_dependencies.statement: Decreasing reciprocal rectangle comparison for t>=2, integral of 1/(s-1) on [2,T+1], T>=1.
necessary_source_dependencies.sourceStatus: Printed picture and integral, including T=1 zero integral.

necessary_source_dependencies.statement: (constant + 4 ln T)/T tends to zero along positive natural horizons; fixed comparator regret <= true-best regret.

Provide actual FTL true-best lower control/variance identity sufficient for ordinary normalized zero; alternatively prove direct convergence. Do not assume arbitrary algorithm regret nonnegative. IID success uses its separate nonnegative excess.
necessary_source_dependencies.sourceStatus: Necessary for stronger zero-limit guarantee; not inferred from finite upper bound alone.

necessary_source_dependencies.statement: For T>0 same later predictions cancel: regret(a)=regret(1/2)+(a-y1)^2-(1/2-y1)^2. Legal a gives first-term <=1 and refined 1+4 tail; correction/T tends zero.
necessary_source_dependencies.sourceStatus: Derived bridge for retained any-initial source guarantee.

necessary_source_dependencies.statement: For every measurable bounded causal policy and positive horizon, produce a legal target sequence with regret Omega(log T); deterministic case or seed expectation with witness chosen outside expectation. Binary observations suffice as legal adversary subset. Need actual learner-dependent regret lower-bound producer and attained comparator identification, not just harmonic growth.

lower_bound_contract_review.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.GuessingLower.randomized_log_lower
lower_bound_contract_review.exact_contract: For any probability space of private seeds, any A: seed -> List Bool -> real, measurable in seed for every history and pointwise [0,1]-valued, every T>0 has a deterministic binary vector v of length T with log(T+2)/6 <= integral_seed pathRegret(A(seed),v).
lower_bound_contract_review.causal_semantics: causalPredict passes only reversed strict-prefix observations to A. pathRegret uses shared comparatorRegret against empiricalMean of same finite binaryValues path. Terminal invokes randomized_harmonic_lower, then log_add_one_le_harmonic.
lower_bound_contract_review.rate_verdict: Actual recorded Omega(log T) learner-regret lower bound, not merely positive/nonzero or analytic harmonic seed.
lower_bound_contract_review.model_verdict: Restricting a scalar-history causal learner to binary histories gives the quantified policy; binary path is legal in [0,1]. Seed expectation witness order is correct. Deterministic policies specialize to trivial seed. No sharp minimax coefficient or high-probability claim is required by the printed qualitative assertion.
lower_bound_contract_review.remaining: No proof-body/dependency audit or compilation rerun performed; exact formal restriction adapter for any wider claimed policy representation must be checked if such representation is claimed. Do not invent arbitrary external protocol coverage as source premise.
